video.description: Source video for lip sync. MP4/MOV/WebM, max 100MB, max 1920px, max 60s.
video.title: Video

audio.description: Audio file to sync. MP3/WAV/M4A/AAC, max 60s. Provide either audio or tts_text.
audio.title: Audio

tts_text.description: Text for TTS lip sync (max 200 chars). Provide either tts_text or audio.
tts_text.title: Tts Text

tts_speaker_id.description: TTS voice ID. Use 'auto' for automatic selection. Required when using tts_text.
tts_speaker_id.title: Tts Speaker Id
